If train Q ran 25% faster on the same route with the same departure time, it would arrive at
solution:
Q's speed $=\frac{300}{4}=75$ km/h; 25% faster $=93.75$ km/h.
Time $=\frac{300}{93.75}=3.2$ h $=3$ h 12 min (time falls by 20%, not 25%).
Arrival $=07{:}15+3{:}12=10{:}27$.
Trap: cutting the time by 25% gives 10:15; reading 3.2 h as 3 h 20 min gives 10:35.

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
fmt='%H:%M'
rows={'P':('06:00','10:30',360),'Q':('07:15','11:15',300),'R':('08:40','13:10',405),'S':('22:30','03:30',470)}
def hrs(a,b):
    t=(datetime.strptime(b,fmt)-datetime.strptime(a,fmt))
    if t.total_seconds()<0: t+=timedelta(days=1)
    return t.total_seconds()/3600
dep,arr,dist=rows['Q']
v=dist/hrs(dep,arr)*1.25
t=datetime.strptime(dep,fmt)+timedelta(hours=dist/v)
res=t.strftime(fmt)
ans = [ 'ABCD'[OPTS.index(r)] for r in res ] if isinstance(res, list) else 'ABCD'[OPTS.index(res)]
